EmailTemplate.description: BT HRS and CL - Used to inform clients of the Customer Satisfaction Survey they will be receiving and to encourage use.
EmailTemplate.name: QTP-Client Satisfaction Survey
EmailTemplate.subject: Insperity Client Satisfaction Survey
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <Client name>,
We are reaching out to inform you of an upcoming satisfaction survey that will be sent to you. The survey will arrive from Surveys@insperity.com, and we sincerely hope you can participate. Your insights are crucial to us; they enable us to tailor our services to better meet the evolving demands of your business.
The feedback you provide is not only appreciated but will be directly communicated to our corporate office, ensuring that your experience helps shape our offerings. Should you have any inquiries or need further assistance, please feel free to contact me.
Thank you for your continued partnership and for taking the time to help us improve.
